calls.purpose: Transcribed sales-call recordings (spoken intent; date-matched to a requirement for UC2).

pns_calls.purpose: PNS masked-number call log — products/categories called about (sourcing basket), caller telecom circle (location hint), offer_id linking a call to a BuyLead, + transcribed spoken intent.

csl.purpose: On-site search/browse clickstream — base parsed activity + ID-decoded category/city/product NAMES.

requirement.purpose: BuyLeads ⨝ ISQ — declared demand + answered specs, category-named, with status/recency. The current-requirement signal.

whatsapp.purpose: One chronological WhatsApp timeline — buyer turns = signal, our offers = context.

pns.purpose: AI-distilled sales-call insights — buyer SPOKE (highest intent/requirement/location trust).

external.purpose: Paid external identity/trust (Befisc+Sign3) — name/email/mobile/PAN/gender/age/location/income TRIANGULATED vs identity for confidence. Cross-check, never primary intent.

mobiles.purpose: Buyer phone triangulated across Profile/Befisc/Sign3 — ≥2 sources = VERIFIED number, all 3 = triple-verified.

pan_union.purpose: PANs from Sign3 phone_to_pan + Befisc + Profile, deduped/source-tagged + Sign3 pan_advance authoritative entity type (Individual/Company/Firm...) & sole-prop/director flags → b2b_b2c.

gstin_union.purpose: GSTINs from Sign3 pan_gst_search + IDfy pan_gst_link + Befisc + Profile, deduped, found_by-tagged; multi-state count = scale/B2B.

gst_detail_union.purpose: Per-field GST consensus across Sign3 gst_validate + IDfy ind_gst_certificate + Befisc FFFQ — each field carries canonical value, agreement_count, and raw per-vendor values. ≥2 agree ⇒ high-confidence industry/constitution/nature deduction; disagreements surfaced for arbitration.

web_osint.purpose: Web/OSINT (Parallel.ai deep search) — public digital footprint the registries cannot see: website, employee_count/size, socials + activity level, Google-Business rating/reviews, Udyam, other businesses, recent news, year_established. Corroboration + scale/legitimacy/digital-maturity; cross-validates KYB identity (web address vs GST address, web business_type vs GST constitution). NEVER overrides KYB identity.

udyam.purpose: Sign3 Udyam/MSME registration (PAN→Udyam→details) — enterprise_type (Micro/Small/Medium = authoritative SIZE band), major_activity, organization_type, NIC industry codes+descriptions, official address, incorporation date. Government MSME record: hard SIZE + industry + entity signal; official_address triangulates GST/web address.

buyerprofile.purpose: IndiaMART buyer record — business_type, MCAT interests, products SOLD (also-a-seller), cleaned social, geo, activity, verification.

company_reg.purpose: IndiaMART VERIFIED GST/KYB record — constitution, nature, turnover band, reg year, PAN, partner names. PRIMARY registry authority.

pan_gst_idfy.purpose: IDfy PAN→all-GSTINs — registration count + multi-state footprint (scale/B2B signal); complements Befisc GSTIN discovery.

gst_cert_idfy.purpose: IDfy GST Certificate — legal/trade name, constitution, nature_of_business (retail/wholesale/mfg/import/export), taxpayer type, vintage, filing-compliance history. Second independent KYB source: triangulates Befisc-Advanced.
